profile.name: Mariia Steeghs-Turchina
profile.headline: Computational neuroscientist & research software engineer
profile.bio:
My background is a random walk through physics, machine learning, computer
science, electrical engineering, and especially mathematics, with a focus on
modeling. At the University of Amsterdam I work on mathematical and
computational models of EEG. At Leiden University Medical Center and ELIXIR
I build software and infrastructure for open science, FAIR research software,
and interoperability in bioinformatics.

Implementing and demonstrating proteomics use cases, developing workflows that connect proteomics data with genomic, structural, and molecular-interaction resources
Collaborating with ELIXIR to develop tools enabling FAIR principles and open-source practices for research software
